text: ２のしまと　３のしまに　ふねで　いける　パスポートです　それと　これもどうぞ！

structure.jp: ２のしまと　３のしまに　ふねで　いける
structure.en: that lets you go to Two Island and Three Island by ship

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ふねで　いける　パスポート
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb, put right before a thing, describes that thing. ふねで　いける　パスポート = 'a pass you can go by ship with'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing いく to いける turns 'go' into 'can go'. いける = 'can go'.
